title: Special identities of nonsymmetric bicommutative operations in associative algebra with an operator
summary: Let $A$ be an associative non-unital algebra with a linear operator $S$ satisfying \[aS(S(b)c)=S(aS(b))c,\] and define $a\prec b=aS(b)$ and $a\succ b=S(a)b$. We determine the special identities of these two operations. If $K_n$ is the arity-$n$ kernel of the corresponding operad morphism and $D_n$ is the space of consequences of smaller-arity kernel elements, then for every $n\geq8$ the quotient $K_n/D_n$ has dimension $n-2$. A basis is given by the classes of $F_{n-2}$, $ρF_{n-2}$, $G_{n-3}$, $ρG_{n-3}$, $J_{n-4}$, $ρJ_{n-4}$ and $H_{p,n-p-1}$, $4\leq p\leq n-5$. The upper bound is proved…
